name: Independent Comics Deep Dive
notes: Adds 803 additional independent and historical direct-market comics authorities across Top Cow, Mad Cave, Scout, Devil's Due, AWA, Malibu, Caliber, NOW, Source Point, Red 5, Kitchen Sink, Moonstone, Dreamwave, Top Shelf, Pacific, Innovation, Titan, Zenescope and many other publishers. Complements the v4.29 expansion while preserving existing records and local edits.
